components.name: MorphingTabs
components.doc: Tabs with a liquid active pill. The pill is a clipped copy of the tab row in the accent color, so the label under it inverts exactly at its edge. When the selection moves, the leading edge springs ahead and the trailing edge follows: the pill stretches, thins and squares off on the way, then settles back into a pill at the new width. The panel leaves and enters along the same direction.
